title: NHTSA 22V412000 — Ford Motor Company (MUSTANG MACH E)

campaign.Component: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:PROPULSION SYSTEM:TRACTION BATTERY:MANAGEMENT SYSTEM/ENERGY CONTROL MODULE (BMS/BECM):SOFTWARE
campaign.Summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2021-2022 Mustang Mach-E vehicles.  The high voltage battery main contactors may overheat.
campaign.Consequence: An overheated high voltage battery contactor may cause the vehicle to lose drive power, increasing the risk of a crash.
campaign.Remedy: Dealers will update the on-board software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed on July 8, 2022.  Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332.  Ford's number for this recall is 22S41.
campaign.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.
